description: Close the three unclosed design-review findings (A/B/C) by editing docs/oop-architecture.md, then add the shared OOP foundation that the entries pilot and all later phases depend on: DomainError hierarchy, SqliteUnitOfWork, and the composition-root skeleton. No existing runtime code is changed yet (new files only + doc edits), so the whole app keeps compiling and all tests keep passing. This feature unblocks FEAT-002. Independent of frontend; must run FIRST because every later feature imports from src/domain/errors.ts and src/lib/unitOfWork.ts and uses src/server/container.ts.
steps: Read docs/oop-architecture.md and .agents/tasks/design-carryover.md and .agents/tasks/design-review.json FIRST. These drive the three doc edits below.

[Finding A — MEDIUM] Edit docs/oop-architecture.md so permission judgement lives in the Application Service for ALL FOUR use cases (submit/submitWaitlist/cancel/updateMembers), behavior-preserving (same wording/branches, only relocated from the adapter). Concretely: (i) rewrite §6.2.2 cancel step 1 so EntryApplicationService.cancel decides owner/team-leader/admin using an injected TeamRepository (remove the phrase that says the adapter looks up Team and decides); (ii) add to the §2.5 Application Service duty list the item: permission judgement as a domain precondition (self / team leader / admin, leader-only categories); (iii) confirm §2.6 adapter duties remain session + Zod + wiring + exception->Result (toActionResult) + revalidate only (no permission judgement).

[Finding B — NIT] Edit docs/oop-architecture.md §10 step 6 to add one regulation-revision item: annotate regulation §2 (directory names = kebab-case) that backend OOP layer directories domain/application/infrastructure (and existing server/types/utils) are single lowercase words, reflecting design §3 naming into the regulation body at the same granularity as the §1.2 extension. (The actual regulation edit is performed in FEAT-005; here only the plan item in §10 step 6 is added.)

[Finding C — NIT] Edit docs/oop-architecture.md: in §6.2.1 submitWaitlist pseudocode add a line that user = this.users.findById(cmd.userId) and team = this.teams.findById(cmd.teamId) are fetched by the Application Service from injected repositories, with role = user.role and isAdmin = user.isAdmin; in §6.2.2 cancel state that policy is created at the top of cancel via new CancelFeePolicy() (stateless VO).

Create src/domain/errors.ts with the DomainError hierarchy exactly per design §4.1: abstract DomainError extends Error with abstract readonly code; subclasses EntryFullError('ENTRY_FULL'), DuplicateEntryError('DUPLICATE_ENTRY'), DuplicateWaitlistError('DUPLICATE_WAITLIST'), EntryNotCancellableError('NOT_CANCELLABLE'), TournamentNotOpenError('TOURNAMENT_NOT_OPEN'), NotFoundError('NOT_FOUND'), MemberCompositionError('INVALID_MEMBERS'); PermissionContext union (cancel|updateMembers|leaderOnlySubmit|leaderOnlyWaitlist|teamOwnership); PermissionDeniedError('PERMISSION_DENIED') holding readonly context: PermissionContext; ConflictConfirmationRequiredError('CONFLICT_CONFIRM') holding readonly conflictTournaments: string[]. No any. Keep it DB/Zod/Next-free (pure TS).

Create src/lib/unitOfWork.ts exporting class SqliteUnitOfWork with constructor(private readonly db: DatabaseSync) and run<T>(work: () => T): T that does db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE'); try { const r = work(); db.exec('COMMIT'); return r; } catch (e) { db.exec('ROLLBACK'); throw e; }. Import DatabaseSync from node:sqlite (type-only import is fine). Non-nested, synchronous — matches current node:sqlite usage.

Create src/server/container.ts composition-root skeleton: import { db } from '@/lib/db' and export factory functions that wire Application Services to their Sqlite repository implementations + SqliteUnitOfWork. In FEAT-001 it may contain only the shared wiring that compiles with no runtime services yet (e.g. a documented placeholder export or an empty module with the import of db and SqliteUnitOfWork). The concrete createEntryApplicationService() factory (design §7) is added in FEAT-002. Ensure the file type-checks with no unused-import errors (if a placeholder is needed, add one tiny exported factory that is wired in FEAT-002).
Do NOT modify src/lib/db.ts or any Server Action in this feature. Do NOT delete any existing utils yet.
acceptance_criteria: docs/oop-architecture.md §6.2.2 places permission judgement in the Application Service (not the adapter); §2.5 duty list includes permission judgement; §6.2.1 and §6.2.2 state the User/Team/policy fetch sites; §10 step 6 includes the regulation §2 directory-naming annotation item.
src/domain/errors.ts, src/lib/unitOfWork.ts, src/server/container.ts exist and compile.
npm test passes the same 43 tests / 12 files as the baseline (nothing newly broken).
npm run build succeeds if the data/gran.db WAL lock is free; if the external lock blocks it, tsc + tests are green and the build blocker is recorded as the external lock (per context.json).
verification: npm test  (expect 43 passed / 12 files, 0 failed; dataRepository.results.test.ts Property 7 still passes)

npm run build  (expect success; if it fails ONLY with SQLite 'database is locked' at src/lib/db.ts, confirm no dev server holds data/gran.db and record the external-lock caveat rather than treating it as a regression)
findings:
Shared OOP foundation is in place for FEAT-002 (entries pilot) and all later phases.

NEW FILES (import paths later FEATs use):
- src/domain/errors.ts — DomainError hierarchy. Import via '@/domain/errors'. Exports: abstract DomainError (abstract readonly code: string); subclasses EntryFullError('ENTRY_FULL'), DuplicateEntryError('DUPLICATE_ENTRY'), DuplicateWaitlistError('DUPLICATE_WAITLIST'), EntryNotCancellableError('NOT_CANCELLABLE'), TournamentNotOpenError('TOURNAMENT_NOT_OPEN'), NotFoundError('NOT_FOUND'), MemberCompositionError('INVALID_MEMBERS'); PermissionDeniedError('PERMISSION_DENIED') with readonly context: PermissionContext; ConflictConfirmationRequiredError('CONFLICT_CONFIRM') with readonly conflictTournaments: string[]. PermissionContext = 'cancel'|'updateMembers'|'leaderOnlySubmit'|'leaderOnlyWaitlist'|'teamOwnership'. Pure TS (no db/Zod/Next). The adapter's toActionResult(error, context?) (FEAT-002) maps these to user-facing wording per oop-architecture.md §4.2 (1-byte-identical). PermissionDeniedError/ConflictConfirmationRequiredError error.message is empty — carry context/conflictTournaments, not message.
- src/lib/unitOfWork.ts — class SqliteUnitOfWork, import via '@/lib/unitOfWork'. constructor(private readonly db: DatabaseSync); run<T>(work: () => T): T does BEGIN IMMEDIATE / COMMIT / (on throw) ROLLBACK+rethrow. Synchronous, non-nested, one run per use case (§6.1). Uses type-only import of DatabaseSync from node:sqlite.
- src/server/container.ts — composition root, import via '@/server/container'. Currently exports ONLY createUnitOfWork(): SqliteUnitOfWork (wires the shared db singleton). FEAT-002 must add createEntryApplicationService() here (design §7) and reuse createUnitOfWork() (or inline new SqliteUnitOfWork(db)) for the service's UoW. Do not new Sqlite*Repository outside this file.

DOC EDITS CLOSING design-review findings A/B/C (docs/oop-architecture.md):
- A (MEDIUM): permission judgement now lives in the Application Service for all four use cases. §2.5 duty list adds 'permission judgement as a domain precondition (self/team-leader/admin, leader-only categories)'; §6.2.2 cancel step 1 rewritten to EntryApplicationService.cancel deciding via injected TeamRepository/UserRepository (adapter no longer judges permission); §2.6 explicitly states permission judgement is NOT an adapter duty (adapter = session+Zod+wiring+toActionResult+revalidate only).
- B (NIT): §10 step 6 adds a regulation-revision item to annotate regulation §2 (directory names = kebab-case) that domain/application/infrastructure (and server/types/utils) are single lowercase words. The ACTUAL regulation edit to .github/Antigravity-instructions.md is deferred to FEAT-005.
- C (NIT): §6.2.1 submitWaitlist pseudocode now declares user=this.users.findById(cmd.userId), team=this.teams.findById(cmd.teamId), role=user.role, isAdmin=user.isAdmin fetched by the Application Service; §6.2.2 cancel states policy=new CancelFeePolicy() created at top of cancel (stateless VO).

NOT TOUCHED (per step constraints): src/lib/db.ts unchanged; no Server Action changed; no existing utils deleted.

VERIFICATION (this commit): npx tsc --noEmit exit 0; npm test 43 passed / 12 files 0 failed (dataRepository.results.test.ts Property 7 passed); npm run build exit 0 (external data/gran.db WAL lock was free this run, so the build succeeded end-to-end).
